title: STM32WLE5CCU6 FCC Frequency Hopping
content:
Hello,

 

I hope all is well.

 

I’m also looking for the FCC test report for the STM32WLE5CCU6. I noticed someone else had requested it previously, but the inquiry seemed to be redirected and may not have been followed through. In short, I will need someone from your compliance or technical team to contact me directly via email.

 

We are currently working on the FCC frequency‑hopping requirements, and I’d like to understand how this was handled on your side and hopefully obtain some manufacturer guidance. Thank you in advance.

scraped_replies.html:
@g9413015  ST run this community. But it is not a direct support (one to one) channel. It is an open Community where everyone is able to access and contribute to all cases (users and ST employees). So, if you are looking for someone from ST technical team to contact you directly. OLS should do the job.

II

Hello ​@g9413015 

For such request, I suggest you contact ST’s local Sales and marketing team or one of ST FAEs. You can also submit a direct support request on The ST online Support platform.

Best Regards.
II

Hi ​@Issamos 

Many thanks for getting back to me. I don’t understand why Sales would be involved in addressing technical questions about your products. I’m really hoping for straightforward communication rather than going through unnecessary cycles. I thank you in advance. Cheers.

Hello ​@g9413015 

First, I’m not representing ST here. I’m a Community member and not an ST employee. 
For the recommandation, some of the internal information may need a one to one discussion with ST. For such kind of discussion (that may require an NDA or something), you should use a privet channel and not the community. That’s why I’ve suggested OLS.

Best Regards.

II

As ​@Issamos said, you probably need to contact ST direct for this.

You can find your local Sales Office here: https://www.st.com/content/st_com/en/contact-us.html

Hi Andrew,

 

Many thanks for getting back to me. I’m a bit confused — why is Sales handling this technical question? It is the ST chip set we are talking about here. Many thanks. Cheers.

It’s not really a technical question, is it ?

You’re asking for regulatory documentation - which is not something that this community forum has access to.
